name: Tomball Marketplace
summary: Tomball Marketplace is a well-regarded community shopping center on FM 2920 in Tomball, Texas, managed by Kimco Realty. With a 4.4-star rating from over 2,100 reviews, it serves as a convenient retail destination for the northern Houston suburban market.
demographics: Tomball Marketplace serves the growing northern Houston suburban market, attracting primarily middle-income families and households with median incomes ranging from $60,000 to $90,000. The trade area draws from Tomball and surrounding communities along FM 2920, appealing to a mix of young families, established homeowners, and retirees seeking convenient shopping options. Typical visitors are value-conscious shoppers who prefer one-stop shopping experiences combining grocery, retail, and service-oriented tenants in an accessible open-air format.
description: Tomball Marketplace is a community shopping center strategically located at 14251 Farm to Market 2920 in Tomball, Texas, serving the rapidly expanding northern Houston metropolitan area. Managed by Kimco Realty, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air shopping centers, this property provides convenient access to essential retail and services for the surrounding suburban communities. The center operates daily with extended hours from 9:30 AM to 8:00 PM, making it accessible for both weekday and weekend shopping trips. With a strong 4.4-star rating from over 2,100 Google reviews, Tomball Marketplace has established itself as a trusted neighborhood destination for local residents. The center's location along the busy FM 2920 corridor positions it perfectly to capture traffic from Tomball's growing residential developments and serves as a vital retail hub for this thriving Texas community.
